note: These are manually curated, typical congestion points — NOT a live feed. SafeSteps is a static offline-first app with no backend, so it can't pull real-time Google Maps traffic data (that needs a paid, key-protected API call from a server). Each point instead links out to Google Maps' live traffic layer for that exact spot so users can check current conditions on demand. Update 'typicalTimes' and 'description' as patterns change, and add new points as they're reported. Community members can also add live jam reports in-app (Report tab → Traffic Jam), which show on this same map layer.
